set.body: Scope: retain DatasetIndex/DatasetRunQuery/DataSelection; make DatasetRun a checked zero-copy view over exactly one DatasetTimeAxis block with key.run matching that block; expand multi-run FmriDataset values into indexed run views; translate run-local selections to global indices; add VoxelSelection.Coords with exact-grid cross-run validation and TimepointSelection.Window with run-local bounds. Event attachment validates table structure and referenced run labels only; acquisition-window diagnostics remain in design. Acceptance: mismatched run keys fail, expansion copies no response data, local/global mapping round-trips through DatasetRunPartition, coordinate selection rejects geometry or mask mismatch, overlapping windows work, empty/out-of-range/cross-run windows fail, and shared JVM+JS tests pass.
set.title: Bridge C: checked indexed runs and selection extensions
